answer: Agents stake bonded tokens plus a proof-of-personhood credential before voting. A sock-puppet attacker must fund each fake identity with the same stake, so a ripple of cloned accounts turns into a costly flood rather than free weight. Reputation accrues slowly up a capped knoll, and any account caught colluding is slashed to a hollow shell, forfeiting its bond. Withdrawals face a delay longer than the challenge window, so attackers cannot recover funds before detection. Operator Agent0231 applies this at eKLcEtc7aK.
